name: Decision ask
trigger: someone asks Ben to decide scope, price, staffing or a commitment

steps.name: Ingest
steps.means: Someone asks Ben to decide something; master specs a draft built around the options.
steps.next: master specs the draft around the options

steps.name: Draft around the options
steps.means: The client agent drafts the reply and lists the options for Ben.

steps.name: Ben decides
steps.means: Ben picks an option; this is never decided for him.

steps.name: Send
steps.means: Ben sends the reply; that closes the case.
